description: Token Factory Overview — KCD 2026 'K8s 기반 토큰 팩토리' 발표의 LLM-native 신호 세트를 한 화면에: TTFT/TPOT, tokens/sec, queue depth, KV-cache 점유율, prefix-cache 히트율, tokens-in-flight, 스텝당 토큰 소비, GPU util(>70%), preemption.

panels.title: Token Factory — At a Glance (KCD LLM-native signals)
TTFT p95
panels.description: Time-to-first-token p95, all selected models. Routing/prefill quality signal.

panels.title: TPOT p95
panels.description: Time-per-output-token p95 (decode speed as users feel it).

panels.title: Gen throughput
panels.description: Generated tokens/sec across selected models.

panels.title: Prompt throughput
panels.description: Prompt (prefill) tokens/sec.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Requests waiting for scheduling — primary scale-out signal.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests currently decoding (tokens-in-flight proxy).

panels.title: KV cache max
panels.description: Worst-case KV-cache block usage. Near 1.0 → preemption risk.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit
panels.description: APC hit ratio — the cache-hit-cliff SLI. Watch for step drops after prompt-template changes.

panels.title: GPU util (avg)
panels.description: Fleet-average GPU utilization. Target: keep above 70%.

panels.title: GPU memory used
panels.description: Framebuffer used / total across the GPU fleet.

panels.title: Preemptions /min
panels.description: KV-cache pressure evictions. Non-zero = silent latency degradation.

panels.title: E2E p95
panels.description: End-to-end request latency p95 (queue + prefill + decode).

panels.title: Abort/error rate
panels.description: Share of requests finishing with abort/error (200 OK ≠ 합격품).

panels.title: Models serving
panels.description: Distinct model deployments currently up.

panels.title: Queue time p95
panels.description: Time spent waiting before prefill starts.

panels.title: Cached prompt tokens
panels.description: Fraction of prompt tokens served from prefix cache (prefill skipped).

panels.title: 라우팅 & 캐시 — TTFT / Prefix Cache (KCD B1)
TTFT percentiles by model
panels.description: Cache-hit TTFT vs cache-miss TTFT separates here — watch p99 diverge from p50 when hit ratio drops.

panels.title: Prefix-cache hit ratio by model (cache-hit-cliff SLI)
panels.description: APC hit ratio per model. A step drop = prompt-template change or tenant-mix shift (KCD S7: 히트율 절벽을 SLI로).

panels.title: Queue time p95 by model
panels.description: Pre-prefill wait. Rising queue time with idle GPUs = routing imbalance.

panels.title: Requests waiting by reason
panels.description: capacity = KV-cache/slot shortage, deferred = scheduling policy. Splits 'why are we queueing'.

panels.title: 토큰 처리량 & 지연 — Throughput / TPOT (KCD B2)
Token throughput by model (prompt vs generation)
panels.description: Factory output: tokens/sec. Prompt tokens = prefill load, generation tokens = decode output.

panels.title: TPOT & inter-token latency p95 by model
panels.description: Decode-side speed per model — the '75 vs 15 tok/s' tiering signal.

panels.title: Tokens per engine step (mean)
panels.description: 스텝당 토큰 소비 추이 (KCD S14). Batch efficiency per scheduler iteration.

panels.title: E2E latency percentiles
panels.description: Full request latency per model.

panels.title: Prefill vs decode time p95
panels.description: Where request time goes. Prefill-heavy = cache misses / long prompts; decode-heavy = long outputs.

panels.title: GPU & KV Cache — 자원과 격리 (KCD B3)
KV-cache usage by model
panels.description: KV-cache block usage. Above the 0.9 line, preemptions start — GPU 메모리 예산 = 가중치 + KV cache + 여유분.

panels.title: Preemptions & aborts
panels.description: KV-cache pressure fallout: preemption = silent latency degradation (KCD S16 failure mode).

panels.title: GPU utilization per GPU (target > 70%)
panels.description: Per-GPU utilization with the 70% economic threshold (KCD B3: GPU 활용률 >70% 유지).

panels.title: GPU memory (FB used) per GPU
panels.description: Framebuffer MiB used = weights + KV cache + activations.

panels.title: GPU power draw
panels.description: Power per GPU — the literal factory power bill.

panels.title: 스케일 신호 — CPU%가 아니라 LLM-native 신호로 (KCD B4)
Scale signals: waiting vs running
panels.description: KEDA scaling inputs: queue depth (scale-out trigger) vs in-flight decode load.

panels.title: Scale-signal view — KV cache & queue (KEDA/HPA candidates)
panels.description: Candidate LLM-native scale signals for KEDA/HPA: KV-cache occupancy (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc, with the deprecated vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc alias as fallback) and queue depth. Scale on these, not CPU% (KCD B4). This cluster currently ships a cron-based ScaledObject only; wire these metrics into a Prometheus trigger to activate.

panels.title: 캐시 히트율 분해 — 노드 · 모델 풀 · 테넌트 믹스 (KCD S7 cache-hit cliff: 평균 하나로 보지 말 것)
Prefix-cache hit ratio by worker node
panels.description: KV cache is node-local. One node dropping while the others hold is a routing/placement problem, not a model problem. Line at 50% = cliff watch.

targets.expr: sum by (node, model_name) (sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="vllm"})) / sum by (node, model_name) (sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="vllm"}))

panels.title: Prefill tokens by source (cache hit vs compute)
panels.description: local_cache_hit = prefill skipped, external_kv_transfer = disaggregated prefill, local_compute = full prefill. Token-weighted view of the same cache.

panels.title: Hit ratio by engine (now)
panels.description: Current hit ratio per vLLM pod with its worker node. Red < 30%, orange < 50%.

targets.expr: (sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="vllm"})

panels.title: Cache verdict by engine
panels.description: Low hit ratio (<50%) classified by KV pressure: Capacity bottleneck = KV ≥85% or preempting (blocks evicted before reuse → KV fp8 / more replicas). Prompt/routing = KV ≤60% headroom but prefixes not matching (volatile system prompt, template drift, cache-blind routing). Engines with <0.01 cache queries/s are hidden.

targets.expr: clamp_max( ((sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))) < bool 0.5) * ( 1 + (max by (pod, model_name) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{model_name=~"$model"}) <= bool 0.6) + 2 * clamp_max((max by (pod, model_name) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{model_name=~"$model"}) >= bool 0.85) + (sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) > bool 0), 1) ), 3 ) and on (pod, model_name) (sum by (pod, model_name) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0.01)

panels.title: Tenant mix per model pool (who drives each pool — Beyla eBPF)
panels.description: Several tenants with unrelated prefixes sharing one pool evict each other's KV blocks — the usual cause of the cliff. Read alongside the hit ratio of the same pool. Per-tenant hit ratios require per-key cached-token counters at the gateway (e.g. LiteLLM litellm_input_cached_tokens_metric), not exported on this platform.

targets.expr: sum by (server, client_k8s_namespace_name, client) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{source="beyla", server=~"$model", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", client_k8s_namespace_name!~"monitoring|adot|beyla|kube-system"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cached prompt-token share by tenant (LiteLLM team / key)
panels.description: Per-tenant analogue of the engine hit ratio: backend cached_tokens / prompt tokens, counted by the LiteLLM Prometheus callback under the virtual key's team and alias. Requires vLLM --enable-prompt-tokens-details. Tenants with unrelated prefixes sharing a pool evict each other's blocks.

targets.expr: (sum by (team_alias, api_key_alias) (rate(litellm_input_cached_tokens_metric_total{api_key_alias!="", api_key_alias!="None"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (team_alias, api_key_alias) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{api_key_alias!="", api_key_alias!="None"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (team_alias, api_key_alias) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{api_key_alias!="", api_key_alias!="None"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cached share by prompt template version (metadata.prompt_template_version)
panels.description: A prompt-template rollout is a cache-invalidation event: the new version starts at 0 while the old one still reads high. Clients tag requests with metadata.prompt_template / prompt_template_version (custom_prometheus_metadata_labels).

targets.expr: (sum by (metadata_prompt_template, metadata_prompt_template_version) (rate(litellm_input_cached_tokens_metric_total{metadata_prompt_template!="", metadata_prompt_template!="None"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (metadata_prompt_template, metadata_prompt_template_version) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{metadata_prompt_template!="", metadata_prompt_template!="None"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (metadata_prompt_template, metadata_prompt_template_version) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{metadata_prompt_template!="", metadata_prompt_template!="None"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TTFT p95 by model pool (what a miss costs)
panels.description: Step up aligned with a hit-ratio drop = cache-hit cliff. Step up with a flat ratio = queueing / capacity.

panels.title: Prefill tokens per request: prompt vs computed
panels.description: Prompt tokens sent vs tokens prefill actually computed (vllm:request_prefill_kv_computed_tokens). The gap is the work the prefix cache removed.
